mep.row.no_system: That system no longer exists. Pick another one.
mep.row.no_points: The run has no points, so it has no elevation.
mep.row.system_domain: System {system} does not take this run type ({kind}). Pick a system of the same network type.
mep.row.material_pipes: A material applies to pipes only; this run is a {kind}.
mep.row.no_catalog: The material has no catalog sizes for this run.
mep.err.follow_blocked: A connected run cannot follow this change: there is no room for its leg at the new place. Move the device less, or disconnect the run first.
mep.err.follow_slope: A connected run has a fall that cannot be kept at the new place: it would drop below the least fall of its system. Move the device less in height, or disconnect the run first.
mep.err.follow_port_lost: A connector this run sat on no longer exists after the edit. Move the run away first, or keep the device type.
mep.err.follow_device: This run ends on a device connector and cannot leave it. Move the device instead, or disconnect the run first.
